svg.text: GitOps platform for lab instrument data on Kubernetes + AWS
AWS SSM access, no inbound SSH
SLO · 99% of uploads processed within 30 s
Multi-window burn-rate alerts: 14.4× fast · 6× slow · 3-day leak
Every alert links a runbook · alerts unit-tested with promtool
Business SLI: histogram labelled by outcome, good = success ≤ 30 s
Bad release → page in ~4 min → git revert → recovered
AWS via OIDC, no stored keys
Terraform: VPC · EKS (module v21) · IRSA · GitHub OIDC plan/apply roles · Entra app registrations · S3 state with native locking · Checkov + TFLint in CI
① Lose a node ② Bad release → alert → git revert ③ Postgres failover ④ Restore namespace from backup — runbooks · postmortems · ADRs
